note: City of Arkansas City park on W. Lincoln Ave: a small open camping area with no marked sites around a gravel loop with two covered picnic tables, plus drinking water and a dump station (11/2024 camper). $10 a day on a 72-hour permit, 5 days at most (city fee schedule, January 2026). The city's pages don't say how to register. --Claude
summary: City fee schedule (eff. 2026-01-01) confirms $10/day (fees added) and a 72-hour permit with a 5-day maximum (added). Water and dump come from an 11/2024 camper report (reported). Stored website is now a 404. 'One electric hookup' and 'register at City Hall' are on no page I could read; dropped from the note. Not waterfront stands.
flags: WEBSITE https://www.arkcity.org/parks-facilities/page/newman-park is dead (city site moved to CivicPlus; it serves 'Custom404') -> https://www.arkcity.org/413/Parks-Listing (lists 'Newman Park 111 W. Lincoln Ave. Amenities: Camping'; no Newman Park detail page exists on the new site). Its fee schedule is https://www.arkcity.org/DocumentCenter/View/211/Comprehensive-Fee-Schedule---Jan-2026-Update.
PHONE 620-441-4470 confirmed: city directory 'Parks and Facilities Division 620-441-4470'. City Hall main line is 620-441-4400; RV Life lists 620-441-4401.

WEAK SPOT: the stored note's 'one electric hookup, the rest no-hookup', '8 sites' (inclusion evidence) and 'register at City Hall' trace to a search snippet that I couldn't find on any city page, old or new. The 11/2024 camper marked 'power 1' but says 'There does not seem to be established sites here'. I left hookups and count unwritten and took the hookup line out of the note.
PRESENCE: the city still lists camping at Newman Park and prices it in the January 2026 fee schedule, so it is current, but there's no page of its own.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: imagery shows the park is a gravel loop south of W. Lincoln Ave with a pavilion. The Arkansas River is about 200 m south behind a levee band, with no view through the trees; the Walnut River is east of town, well over 1 km away.
PIN 37.04183,-97.04052 is at the park entrance on Lincoln Ave, about 50 m from the loop's centre (about 37.0415,-97.0401); fine.

ADD LEAD: Walnut Park, 216 W. Birch Ave, Arkansas City - the city lists 'Amenities: Camping, fishing, picnic tables', and the 2026 fee schedule prices camping there at '$10.00/Day' on the same 72-hour, 5-day terms. It isn't in the DB. RV Life has it as park 265965 at 37.05712,-97.02872 (unrated, 0 reviews). It still needs vetting: drive-in RV use and fit are unconfirmed.
